description: Public API for retrieving active sliders. Results are returned in ascending order by sort_order, and the image, mobile_image, and text fields are selected from the translation for the current locale.

endpoints.description: Returns only sliders where is_active=true. Slider data is taken from the translation matching the current locale. If no translation exists for the current locale, the first available translation is used as a fallback.
notes: Only sliders with is_active=true are returned
Results are sorted in ascending order by sort_order
image and mobile_image are no longer stored in the sliders table; they are stored in the slider_translations table
The API retrieves the image and mobile_image fields from the translation matching the current locale
If no translation exists for the current locale, the first available translation is returned as a fallback
image and mobile_image are returned as full public URLs
When action_type=link, button_link may be filled and description may be empty
When action_type=content, description must be filled
hide_text_mobile is applied only at the selected translation level
This endpoint is public and does not require authentication
